It recognizes that the proportional calibration profiles do not identify this force term, then applies the correction for general profiles. The final bounded weighted fit estimates viscosity from data and all seven verifier tests pass.

At public trajectory step 7 explicitly identifies the missing free-charge contribution, tests force variants and recognizes the proportional calibration profiles. Step 10 implements the complete Maxwell force and analytic bounded inverse-viscosity fit. The final source implements the required physics for independent conductivity/permittivity patterns and all seven verifier tests pass.

After calibration and resolution checks, public trajectory step 14 explicitly adds the general free-charge Maxwell-force contribution required for differing conductivity/permittivity profiles. The final source computes div(epsilon*E)*E minus the dielectric-gradient force and retains the correct current/Stokes solution. Its intermediate scratch broadcasting bug is fixed before the final implementation; all seven verifier tests pass.
